summary: own-dashboard has 134 test files named for marketing/DNESKAi/carousel-studio (152 that mention either word) out of 200 unit test files, 25 PGlite migration-replay suites and 4 marketing/DNESKAi e2e specs (19 test() calls), all run by one GitHub workflow (ci.yml: check job lint, tsc, vitest, build, check:render-traces; e2e job Playwright + axe). Four coupled gates tie it to Quorum: the vendored tree hash, reproduction of the 11 pinned DNESKAi golden PNG hashes, the template-derived DNESKAI_FIELD_FACES/DNESKAI_PLACED_FIELDS and DNESKAI_TEXT_LIMITS. Quorum's studio carries 33 test files (683 tests measured) plus 92 consumer files across orchestrator and site, so the studio cannot leave Quorum: option (b) is a copy that diverges, and option (c) still drags 28 of 41 studio modules (81% of the source lines). Measured on this Mac: the marketing/DNESKAi vitest set (137 files, 1,340 tests) fails 11-12 tests under the host time zone (CEST) and Node 26, and 4 with TZ=UTC; CI on Node 22/UTC is green (last main run 6 min 47 s). The suite silently depends on TZ=UTC and Node 22, and the PGlite replays pin a cron prune job production lacks.

findings.title: The unit suite silently assumes TZ=UTC: 11-12 DNESKAi tests fail on the owner's Mac
findings.claim: Nothing pins the time zone for vitest. Tests compare timestamps formatted by the database/driver in the host zone with UTC literals, so on a Prague-zone machine dneskai-dry-day (6 tests) and marketing-dneskai-briefs-flow-database fail; CI passes only because GitHub runners use UTC.
findings.recommendation: Set process.env.TZ = 'UTC' at the top of vitest.config.ts (or a globalSetup) and say so in docs; rerun the set to prove it.

truth.evidence: Reopened briefs-flow test :83 (UTC literals); vitest.config.mts has no TZ. Measured: host TZ 11-12 failures, TZ=UTC removes all dry-day/briefs-flow failures in isolation.

findings.title: Node version is unpinned locally; Node 26 breaks the DNESKAi tab-visibility tests
findings.claim: CI uses Node 22, but package.json has no engines field and there is no .nvmrc. On Node 26 the global localStorage shadows happy-dom's and project-tab-visibility.test.tsx fails all 3 tests.
findings.recommendation: Add "engines": {"node": ">=22 <25"} and a .nvmrc with 22, or make the test use window.localStorage from happy-dom explicitly.

truth.evidence: ci.yml:22 Node 22; no engines/.nvmrc; node 26 prints 'localStorage is not available because --localstorage-file was not provided' and the 3 tests fail with localStorage undefined.
